title: Auto close RDP sessions once logged out
author: happpyg
body_snippet:
Hi Team,
Not sure this is the most appropriate place for this question.

I have been using the original version of mRemoteNG (1.77.3 NB) and then I found this version which is much better.  However there is one small thing I can't find an answer for.

In my original 1.77.3 version, after I log off an RDP session, that pane/window closes automatically in mRemote however in this version (1.82.0) it does not.  Is that something configurable i'm missing?

Please advise if I should direct this questi...

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Welcome, and glad the fork is working well for you!

Good news — this is configurable, not a bug. What changed since 1.77.3 is that this fork added a "keep tabs open" feature (from a long-standing upstream request, #1444), and it ships **enabled** by default:

**Tools → Options → Tabs & Panels → uncheck "Keep tabs open after disconnecting"**

With that unchecked you get exactly the 1.77.3 behavior: when you log off (or the connection drops), the tab closes itself immediately. With it checked, th...
